# TLS data: load and crop to only beaver meadows plots - save with other fall25rx clean data
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

vars <- read.csv("Data - Working/CORMP_intelimon_through_10152026.csv")
vars <- vars %>% filter(str_detect(h_filename, "CORM8_8002|CORM8_8004|CORM8_8005|CORM8_8008|CORM8_8009|CORM8_8014|CORM8_8015|CORMP_0052|CORMP_0051|CORMP_0055|CORMP_0020"))

#add column for treatment status, filter out unwanted scans, and rename plot names
vars <- vars %>% slice(c(1:14, 16:18, 20:22, 24:26, 28:30))
vars <- vars %>% mutate(Status = c("PreBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", "Year01",
                                   "PreBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", "PostBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", "PostBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", "PostBurn", "Year01", "PreBurn", 
                                   "PostBurn", "Year01"))
vars <- vars %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(str_detect(h_filename, "CORM8_8002") ~ "8002", str_detect(h_filename, "CORM8_8004") ~ "8004", 
                                         str_detect(h_filename, "CORM8_8005") ~ "8005", str_detect(h_filename, "CORM8_8008") ~ "8008", 
                                         str_detect(h_filename, "CORM8_8009") ~ "8009", str_detect(h_filename, "CORM8_8014") ~ "8014",
                                         str_detect(h_filename, "CORM8_8015") ~ "8015", str_detect(h_filename, "CORMP_0020") ~ "PIPS_14", 
                                         str_detect(h_filename, "CORMP_0051") ~ "PIPS_02", str_detect(h_filename, "CORMP_0052") ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                         str_detect(h_filename, "CORMP_0055") ~ "PIPS_05"))

#delete unwanted columns
vars <- vars %>% select(c(Plot, Status, 174:180, 182:187, 191:198, 266:274))


vars <- vars %>% mutate(EastFuelsTotalAll = case_when(Status == "PreBurn" ~ EastFuelsPreTotalAll, Status == "PostBurn" ~ EastFuelsPostTotalAll,
                                                      Status == "Year01" ~ EastFuelsYr01TotalAll, TRUE ~ NA_real_))
vars <- vars %>% select(Plot, Status, EastFuelsTotalAll, EastMeanCBH, EastLiveTreeCount, EastTotalTreeCount, EastRXMeanScHt, EastRXMeanScPct, mGCvol, mUSvol, mMSvol, mOSvol, GCvol, USvol, MSvol, OSvol)

write.csv(vars, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/intelimonscandata_pre_post_year01.csv")
```

#Now that the data has been somewhat tidyd, make dataframes containing the following, merging TLS data with FFI data:

*TREES: need to calculate: TBA, BasalArea, MeanTH, MDBH, TreesN, MaxTH, SDHT, StemsPacre for ffi data (and for model outputs: meanCBH, meanScHt, meanScPct, TotalTreeCount)

*Fuels: pre, post, year01 fuels


*mGCvol, mUSvol, mMSvol, mOSvol with shrub and veg cover data, fuels data, CBH & scorch data

BS-substrate burn severity
```{R}
bs <- read.csv("Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_post_BURNSEVERITY.csv")
vars <- read.csv("Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/intelimonscandata_pre_post_year01.csv")
vars <- vars %>% filter(Status == "PostBurn")
vars <- vars %>% select(c(Plot,EastRXSubSev))

bs_merged <- left_join(bs, vars)
bs_merged <- bs_merged %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, SubSev, EastRXSubSev))
bs_merged <- bs_merged %>% rename(FFISubSev = SubSev, TLSSubSev = EastRXSubSev) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(FFISubSev, TLSSubSev), names_to = "DataSource", values_to = "SubSev")

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(bs_merged, aes(x = DataSource, y = SubSev)) + geom_boxplot()

```
*I think the models were built using this data so this might not be worthwhile - but if we do burn this fall... then maybe we'll have something

Fuels
```{r}
fuels <- read.csv("Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_post_year01_FUELS.csv")
fuels <- fuels %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, TotalAll))

vars <- read.csv("Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/intelimonscandata_pre_post_year01.csv")
vars <- vars %>% select(c(Plot,Status, EastFuelsTotalAll)) %>% rename(PlotStatus = Status)

fuels_merged <- left_join(fuels, vars)

fuels_merged <- fuels_merged %>% rename(FFITotalAll = TotalAll, TLSTotalAll = EastFuelsTotalAll) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(FFITotalAll, TLSTotalAll), names_to = "DataSource", values_to = "TotalFuelLoad")

fuels_merged$PlotStatus <- factor(fuels_merged$PlotStatus, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn", "Year01"), ordered = TRUE)

ggplot(fuels_merged, aes(x = PlotStatus, y = TotalFuelLoad, fill = DataSource)) + geom_boxplot()

ttest1 <-  fuels_merged %>% group_by(PlotStatus) %>% do(tidy(t.test(TotalFuelLoad ~ DataSource, data = .)))

#separate out ben's plots
fuels_merged <- fuels_merged %>% mutate(PlotCategory = case_when(startsWith(Plot, "8") ~ "bensplots", startsWith(Plot, "PIPS") ~ "FMH", TRUE ~ NA_character_))


ggplot(fuels_merged, aes(x = PlotStatus, y = TotalFuelLoad, fill = DataSource)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(vars(PlotCategory))

 
library(dplyr)
library(broom)

ttest <- fuels_merged %>%
  group_by(PlotStatus, PlotCategory) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(TotalFuelLoad ~ DataSource, data = .)))

#not great. ben's data is significantly different for tls vs fmh
# but lets see if there are any weird outlier plots in his data I can get rid of

#get rid of 8005 and 8009
fuels_merged2 <- fuels_merged %>% filter(Plot != "8009" & Plot != "8005")

ggplot(fuels_merged2, aes(x = PlotStatus, y = TotalFuelLoad, fill = DataSource)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(vars(PlotCategory))

ttest2 <- fuels_merged2 %>%
  group_by(PlotStatus, PlotCategory) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(TotalFuelLoad ~ DataSource, data = .)))

#ok that worked - but lets try just getting rid of one plot
#8005
fuels_merged3 <- fuels_merged %>% filter(Plot != "8005")

ttest3 <- fuels_merged3 %>%
  group_by(PlotStatus, PlotCategory) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(TotalFuelLoad ~ DataSource, data = .)))

#8009
fuels_merged4 <- fuels_merged %>% filter(Plot != "8009" )

ttest4 <- fuels_merged4 %>%
  group_by(PlotStatus, PlotCategory) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(TotalFuelLoad ~ DataSource, data = .)))

# I think it is worth just getting rid of the two plots, there are still 5 plots of ben's data
```

Trees: meanCBH, meanScHt, meanScPct
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
trees <- read.csv("Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_post_year01_TREES.csv")

trees_summary <- trees %>% select(Plot, PlotStatus, Tag.Num., Status, Live.Crown.Base.Ht., Scorch.Ht., Crown.Scorch..)
#filter out dead trees
trees_summary <- trees_summary %>% filter(Status == "L")

trees_summary[is.na(trees_summary)] <- 0


trees_summary <- trees_summary %>% group_by(Plot, PlotStatus) %>% 
  summarise(meanCBH = mean(Live.Crown.Base.Ht.), meanScHt = mean(Scorch.Ht.), meanScPct = mean(Crown.Scorch..)) %>% ungroup()

trees_summary <- trees_summary %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(meanCBH, meanScHt, meanScPct), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>% mutate(DataSource = "FMH")

vars <- read.csv("Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/intelimonscandata_pre_post_year01.csv")

vars <- vars %>% select(Plot, Status, EastMeanCBH, EastRXMeanScPct, EastRXMeanScHt) %>% 
  rename(PlotStatus = Status, meanCBH = EastMeanCBH, meanScHt = EastRXMeanScHt, meanScPct = EastRXMeanScPct)

vars <- vars %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(meanCBH, meanScHt, meanScPct), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>% mutate(DataSource = "TLS")

tree2 <- rbind(trees_summary, vars)

tree2$PlotStatus <- factor(tree2$PlotStatus, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn", "Year01"), ordered = TRUE)


ggplot(tree2, aes(x = PlotStatus, y = value, fill = DataSource)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(vars(metric))




tree2 <- tree2 %>% mutate(PlotCategory = case_when(startsWith(Plot, "8") ~ "bensplots", startsWith(Plot, "PIPS") ~ "FMH", TRUE ~ NA_character_))

tree2 <- tree2 %>% mutate(DataType = case_when(DataSource == "TLS" ~ "TLS",
                                               DataSource == "FMH" ~ "Field")) %>% select(-DataSource)

#(1) CBH
cbh <- tree2 %>% filter(metric == "meanCBH")
cbh <- cbh %>% filter(PlotStatus != "PostBurn")
cbh <- cbh %>% filter(PlotStatus == "Year01")


ggplot(cbh, aes(x = PlotCategory, y = value, fill = DataType)) + geom_boxplot() 

ttest_cbh <- cbh %>%
  group_by(PlotCategory) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(value ~ DataType, data = .)))

#(2) Mean ScPct and meanScHt
ScHt <-  tree2 %>% filter(metric == "meanScHt") %>% filter(PlotStatus != "PreBurn")
ScPct <- tree2 %>% filter(metric == "meanScPct") %>% filter(PlotStatus != "PreBurn")

ggplot(ScPct, aes(x = PlotStatus, y = value, fill = DataType)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(vars(PlotCategory))

ttest_ht <- ScHt %>%
  group_by(PlotCategory) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(value ~ DataType, data = .)))


ttest_pct <- ScPct %>%
  group_by(PlotCategory) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(value ~ DataType, data = .)))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

vars$Status <- factor(vars$Status, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn", "Year01"), ordered = TRUE)
vars <- vars %>% filter(Status == "PreBurn" | Status == "Year01")

t.test(vars$EastMeanCBH ~ vars$Status)
ggplot(vars, aes(Status, EastMeanCBH)) + geom_boxplot() + labs(title = "mean CBH Pre-Burn vs. 1 year Post-Burn (n=11, p = 0.2)") 

t.test(vars$EastFuelsTotalAll ~ vars$Status)

ggplot(vars, aes(Status, EastFuelsTotalAll)) + geom_boxplot()+ labs(title = "Total Fuel Load Pre-Burn vs. 1 year Post-Burn (n=11, p < 0.05)") 

library(tidyverse)
vars2 <- vars %>% select(c(Plot, Status, mGCvol, mUSvol, mMSvol, mOSvol)) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(mGCvol, mUSvol, mMSvol, mOSvol), names_to = "m_vol_category", values_to = "point_volume")
vars2$m_vol_category <- factor(vars2$m_vol_category, levels = c("mGCvol", "mUSvol", "mMSvol", "mOSvol"), ordered = TRUE)
vars2 <- vars2 %>% filter(Status == "PreBurn" | Status == "Year01")

ggplot(vars2, aes(m_vol_category, point_volume, fill = Status)) + geom_boxplot() + labs(title = "Point Volume Pre-Burn vs. 1 Year Post-Burn")





```
